quests.instruction: What number comes right after 12?
quests.hint: Start at 12 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 12 is 13 -- one more than 12!
quests.funFact: A baker's dozen is a friendly extra treat -- 13 instead of 12!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 2 in a line?
quests.hint: Count places in order: 1st, 2nd, 3rd... keep going until you reach position 2.
quests.explanation: Position 2 in a line is called the "Second" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: Number 2 is the only even number that is also a prime number!

quests.instruction: Which number is the smallest: 19, 20, or 21?
quests.hint: The smallest number is the one you'd reach first while counting up from zero.
quests.explanation: Out of 19, 20, and 21, the number 19 is the smallest!
quests.funFact: The number 19 is a prime number -- only 1 and 19 divide it evenly!

quests.instruction: Which number is the greatest: 17, 18, or 12?
quests.hint: Line all three numbers up in counting order first.
quests.explanation: Out of 17, 18, and 12, the number 18 is the greatest!
quests.funFact: Many countries consider 18 the age you officially become an adult!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 24 or 21?
quests.question: 24 or 21
quests.hint: Line the numbers up on a number line in your head -- further right is bigger.
quests.explanation: 24 is greater than 21 -- when counting up, 24 comes later!
quests.funFact: A full day and night together lasts exactly 24 hours!

quests.instruction: Which word describes position number 9 in a line?
quests.hint: This word tells you WHERE something is in line, not how many there are in total.
quests.explanation: Position 9 in a line is called the "Ninth" position -- ordinal words describe order, not amount!
quests.funFact: A baseball team sends exactly 9 players out onto the field!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Sixteen
quests.hint: Say the word out loud, then look for the matching numeral among the choices.
quests.explanation: "Sixteen" is how we say the number 16 in English, so 16 is the digit that matches!
quests.funFact: In many places, 16 is celebrated as a big birthday milestone!

quests.explanation: The numeral 15 is written in words as "Fifteen" -- that's its name!
quests.funFact: A basketball shot clock in some leagues once counted down from 15!

quests.instruction: Which number is greater: 16 or 20?

quests.hint: Picture counting all the way up -- whichever number you'd reach later is the answer.
quests.explanation: 20 is greater than 16 -- when counting up, 20 comes later!
quests.funFact: You have a total of 20 fingers and toes when you count them all!

quests.instruction: Is 25 an odd number or an even number?
quests.hint: Look at the very last digit of 25 -- is it 0, 2, 4, 6, or 8?
quests.explanation: 25 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 25 is Odd!
quests.funFact: A quarter coin is worth exactly 25 cents!

quests.explanation: Out of 25, 12, and 15, the number 25 is the greatest!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 16?
quests.hint: Count up from 16: "16, ...?"
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 16 is 17 -- one more than 16!
quests.funFact: Cicada insects are famous for hiding underground for 17 whole years!

quests.instruction: What number comes between 23 and 25?
quests.question: 23 and 25
quests.hint: This number sits right in the middle, one more than 23 and one less than 25.
quests.explanation: 24 sits exactly between 23 and 25 -- one step up from 23 and one step down from 25!
quests.funFact: A full day and night together lasts exactly 24 hours!

quests.instruction: What number comes right before 22?
quests.hint: The number right before is always one less than the number you're on.
quests.explanation: Counting backward, the number right before 22 is 21 -- one less than 22!
quests.funFact: A standard deck of playing cards is often used to play games up to 21!

quests.instruction: What number comes right after 21?
quests.hint: Start at 21 and take just one more step forward.
quests.explanation: Counting forward, the number right after 21 is 22 -- one more than 21!
quests.funFact: 22 is just 2 away from the round number 20!

quests.instruction: Read the word and find the matching number!
quests.question: Twenty-Four

quests.explanation: "Twenty-Four" is how we say the number 24 in English, so 24 is the digit that matches!

quests.instruction: Is 21 an odd number or an even number?

quests.explanation: 21 cannot be split into two equal groups -- there's always one left over, so 21 is Odd!

quests.explanation: 22 sits exactly between 21 and 23 -- one step up from 21 and one step down from 23!

quests.explanation: 17 is smaller than 22 -- when counting up, 17 comes earlier!
